in_marathi.name: Dhansukh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Prosperity and Happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhansukh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhansukh is a Sanskrit name that combines the words dhan, meaning wealth or prosperity, and sukh, meaning happiness. This name is believed to bring blessings of wealth, prosperity, and happiness in life.
